stories.title: FTC subpoenas OpenAI and Anthropic; eight US states sue OpenAI over ChatGPT harm to children
stories.summary: Axios reports the FTC has sought documents from OpenAI and Anthropic over potential consumer-protection violations and plans to compel top AI executives to testify. In parallel, eight US states are taking legal action against OpenAI over alleged ChatGPT-related harm to children and vulnerable users, according to today's roundups. The one-two hit is the latest escalation in a mounting wave of US regulatory pressure on the frontier labs.

stories.title: AI rout deepens: Nasdaq futures dive 1% as debt and inflation fears hit AI stocks
stories.summary: Nasdaq futures fell more than 1% on Thursday as the AI-stock selloff deepened on fears that higher rates will make AI investment harder to fund, Reuters reports. Wednesday saw the Nasdaq and S&P 500 log their biggest one-day drop since July, with CoreWeave down 15%, Oracle off nearly 9%, and $80 billion wiped out. TSMC's cautious 2027 outlook added to the gloom after a sixth straight record quarter.

stories.title: GlobalFoundries to operate two new US semiconductor fabs under US-Japan partnership
stories.summary: GlobalFoundries has been selected to operate two new semiconductor manufacturing facilities in New York under a US-Japan partnership, today's tech roundup reports. The announcement adds fresh US-based chip capacity at a time when AI demand has kept fabs running hot and TSMC just posted its sixth consecutive record quarter.

stories.title: Blackburn's AI-generated dance meme goes viral on eve of early voting
stories.summary: Tennessee GOP gubernatorial candidate Marsha Blackburn posted an AI-generated meme of herself dancing to Kendrick Lamar's 'Not Like Us' with other state officials, a day before midterm early voting began. The viral post drew satire, criticism from her Democratic opponent, and questions about compliance with a recently passed state law governing AI deepfakes in political advertising.
